whenToUse: A company careers site with culture, benefits, hiring process, a filterable job board and job posts with an apply form.
Employers that need CV upload, right-to-work and consent fields.
avoidWhen: A university department or staff directory — use site-department-01.
A public institution site — use site-public-01.
a11y: The job board is role="search" and result counts are announced via a status region; the apply form validates with visible messages.
Keep the consent checkbox label explicit about what data is stored.
